item_short_desc: A secure, sleek and professional approach to carrying your ammo, Rothco’s Dual Magazine Pouch.
description: A secure, sleek and professional approach to carrying your ammo, Rothco’s Dual Magazine Pouch. This Dual magazine pouch holds two 9MM/ .45 Mags. A sturdy belt loop lets you integrate this mag pouch right onto your duty belt while horizontal or vertical wear capabilities make this duty belt magazine pouch extremely versatile. The poly webbing construction on this duty gear accessory give it superior strength while still being lightweight.
